mandatoryJourneys.description: Tenant → lease → rent configuration → invoice → confirmed send → payment → receipt
Create category → multi-apartment assessment → invoices → collections
Register meter → readings → calculated utility invoice → dispute resolution
Partial payment → allocation → remaining balance → receipt
Overdue tenant → reminder → repayment plan → instalment tracking
Third-party unit rent → authorised fees → owner payout calculation → statement
Payment gross amount → processing fees → net settlement reconciliation
Lease closure → final charges → deposit settlement → refund
Competitor portfolio import → validation → reconciled opening balances
Daily collections report → every source transaction → export
Issued invoice correction → balanced ledger and retained history
Large-portfolio bulk billing → no duplicate or lost transactions
Failed provider requests/background jobs → safe recovery and retries
